# R Session Info {.unnumbered}

This document lists all R packages used across all analysis notebooks in this repository.

```{r}
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE

# Core data manipulation and visualization
library(tidyverse)      # Data manipulation and ggplot2
library(scales)         # Axis scaling and transformations
library(ggtext)         # Markdown text in ggplot2
library(ggpubr)         # Publication-ready plots
library(patchwork)      # Combining plots
library(ggrepel)        # Non-overlapping text labels
library(ggh4x)          # Extended ggplot2 features (faceting)

# Data export
library(writexl)        # Writing Excel files

# Statistical modeling
library(lme4)           # Linear mixed-effects models
library(lmerTest)       # p-values for mixed models
library(emmeans)        # Estimated marginal means and contrasts

# Data summary and tables
library(skimr)          # Data summaries
library(knitr)          # Table formatting with kable()
library(kableExtra)     # Extended table formatting
library(gridExtra)      # Arranging tables and plots

# Specialized analyses
library(mixOmics)       # Multivariate analysis (PCA, PLS-DA)
library(vegan)          # Ecological diversity (rarefaction curves)

# RNA-Seq specific
library(tximport)       # Importing transcript quantification
library(DESeq2)         # Differential expression analysis
library(fgsea)          # Fast gene set enrichment analysis

# Visualization utilities
library(RColorBrewer)   # Color palettes
library(viridis)        # Color palettes
library(Cairo)          # High-quality graphics device

# Interactive visualizations
library(plotly)         # Interactive plots
library(htmltools)      # HTML widgets support
library(htmlwidgets)    # Widget framework

# Graphics utilities
library(grid)           # Low-level graphics
```

## Session Information

This shows the exact versions of R and all packages used in the analysis.

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```
